basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Manchester, UK, exploring the gaming world and its communities. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and am currently working as a junior software developer. I love multiplayer games, especially battle royales and first-person shooters. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy reading up on current events and tech news. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with other gamers for fun and competition.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing various online games, starting with console games in my teens and moving on to PC gaming during university. I've also developed a decent understanding of technology through my academic studies and my current job, which involves coding and software development.
